_comment: First matching rule wins. Match by plugin key + event, or by script name (a whole whitespace-separated token of the command, reduced to its basename). Never absolute paths and never hook ids: ids hash the command, which can hold a machine path. Unmatched hooks bridge, unclassified. Rules for a user's own hooks do not belong here: they go in <OC config dir>/cc-parity-dispositions.json (same schema, merged over these, user entries win).

rules.reason: The composed superpowers OC adapter injects the bootstrap
OC equivalents are hand-ported hooks; serena-hooks has no opencode client
Keys on tool_response.backgroundTaskId, which OC never supplies
A no-op outside cloud sessions, by its own design
